{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==

* 4 thick-cut bone-in [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] rib chops
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] dark [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* 1½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] kosher [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Apple Stuffing|Apple Stuffing]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Chop Rub|Chop Rub]]
* A heat-proof towel tied with twine and soaked with oil

== Procedure ==
#Combine lemon juice, honey, and salt in a gallon-size zip-top bag. Add pork chops, take as much air out as possible, and seal bag. Refrigerate 24 hours.
#Take pork out of marinade. Using a narrow [[Cookbook:Knife|boning knife]], make an incision in the side of the chop until you hit bone. Sweep the knife up and make the hole slightly larger. Repeat with remaining pork chops. Using a bagel slicer helps to stabilize the chops while cutting.
#Place the apple stuffing inside a gallon size zip top plastic bag. Snip a small hole in the corner. Place snipped corner inside incision in one of the pork chops. Squeeze to dispense. Dispense about 2 tbsp into each pork chop.
#Once all pork has been stuffed, massage the chop rub into both sides of each chop. Set aside.
#Quickly lube [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] with the oiled towel. Grill pork over high heat 2 minutes, then rotate 90° and cook for another 2 minutes to get good grill marks. Flip and repeat 1 more time.
#Remove from grill and let rest for 7 minutes. Serve.
